description: Return the PROP SHAPE (field names + what each field takes) for named atoms. get_catalog tells you an atom EXISTS; this tells you how to fill it. Call this before authoring any atom you have not used before — guessing prop names is the single most common cause of an atom rendering empty or wrong. Accepts several types at once, so a multi-atom surface resolves in one call. Each atom also carries `renderers`: renderer id -> measured status (web: drawn, drawn_with_differences, not_verified, not_supported, not_measured; flutter: native, degraded, not_supported, not_measured; compose: native, not_supported, not_measured). Only drawn and native mean it draws as intended; degraded = lowered to Basic components. renderers_matrix is the URL holding the reasons and evidence (atoms[<atom>][<renderer>]). Atoms not yet measured have no renderers.
name: get_atom_schema

atoms.description: Prop shapes keyed by atom type; each value has fields, description, surfaces and, when measured, renderers (renderer id -> status).

hint.description: What to do about the unknown names.

renderers_matrix.description: URL of the renderer matrix with the reasons and evidence behind each renderers status.

unknown.description: Requested names that are not real atoms.
